safety_verdicts.content: Associated symptoms include a sore throat, blocked ears, and a runny nose.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated covers sore throat and runny nose, but does not document blocked ears (only 'no ear pain').
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “blocked ears” slightly reduces symptom completeness for an upper respiratory illness and could affect consideration of otitis media/eustachian tube dysfunction, but it is unlikely to materially change immediate management in an otherwise uncomplicated viral picture.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports no unwell contacts and no nausea or vomiting.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting “no unwell contacts” removes a minor epidemiologic detail (exposure risk) but generally does not alter treatment or safety decisions for a self-limited viral syndrome when other key symptoms and negatives are captured.
